# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.tagline }}

{{ site.description }}

This is a personal, privacy-first blog (no analytics, no tracking) built with Jekyll.
Content is organised into long-form **articles** (essays on philosophy and the history
of ideas) and downloadable **papers** (PDFs). Use the links below to read the source.

## Sections

- [Articles]({{ '/articles/' | absolute_url }}): Essays on philosophy — the great thinkers of ancient and modern times.
- [Papers]({{ '/papers/' | absolute_url }}): Academic papers and longer writings, available as PDFs.
- [Categories]({{ '/categories/' | absolute_url }}): Browse all writing grouped by topic.
- [About]({{ '/about/' | absolute_url }}): About {{ site.author.name }} and this site.

## Optional

- [RSS / Atom feed]({{ '/feed.xml' | absolute_url }}): Full-content feed of new writing.
- [Sitemap]({{ '/sitemap.xml' | absolute_url }}): Machine-readable index of every indexable URL.
